art_direction: Original dark fantasy pixel icons; 24-color foregrounds, fixed type backgrounds.

tiles.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original square dark fantasy pixel-art mobile puzzle tile, no text, no numbers, no logos, no imitation of any existing game. Coarse crisp pixel clusters on a logical 48x48 pixel grid enlarged with hard edges; bold dark outlines, high contrast, only 3 shades per material, no gradients, no blur, no fine texture. Full-bleed opaque flat colored square background with a subtle darker 2-pixel edge. Large readable icon centered slightly above middle, bounding box x=20%-80%, y=12%-76%; keep upper left x<23% y<25%, upper right x>77% y<25%, and bottom middle y>80% quiet empty background for UI numbers. Icon readable at 64px. Subject: a squat glass healing potion bottle with vivid ruby red liquid, a short cork stopper and one broad white glass glint. Burgundy-red background. Single bottle only, fills central area.
